title: Black Bean Huevos Rancheros
description: This black bean huevos rancheros recipe features cheese-filled tortillas topped with spicy black beans, salsa, and a fried egg. A deliciously hearty breakfast!
ingredients: 1.5 cups fresh tomatoes, seeded and finely chopped
1 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped
1 (19 ounce) can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 teaspoon chopped chipotle chiles in adobo sauce

steps.text: To make the salsa: Stir tomatoes, green onions, cilantro, lime juice, jalapeno pepper, 1 clove minced garlic, and salt together in a bowl until well blended. Cover and refrigerate until needed.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease a baking sheet.

Place 1 teaspoon canola oil in a skillet and heat over medium heat. Stir in garlic and cook 1 minute until light brown. Mix in black beans, chicken broth, and chiles; simmer until beans are heated through, about 5 minutes. Turn off the heat and keep warm.
Place four tortillas on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle cheese evenly over tortillas; top with remaining four tortillas. Cover the baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Bake tortillas in preheated oven until cheese melts, about 5 minutes.
Place remaining 1 teaspoon canola oil in a skillet; heat over medium heat. Crack eggs into skillet and cook to desired firmness.
To assemble huevos rancheros: Place cheese-filled tortillas on four serving plates. Top each tortilla with black bean mixture, a layer of salsa, and an egg. Serve immediately.

video.description: Make it an easy meal full of flavor, nutritious ingredients and Mexican flair! First create a bright salsa with tomatoes, green onion, cilantro, lime juice, jalapeno, garlic and salt. Next simmer together garlic, oil, black beans, chicken broth and chipotle pepper. Bake corn tortillas with Monterey Jack cheese, then top with seasoned beans, salsa and an egg. Simple and delicious, you’ll enjoy making this tasty dish for any meal of the day!
